title: TDS Tech (tdstech.com.vn)
description:
Software / digitization services · Vietnam
Full data leak: 2026-11-11 22:32 UTC
This disclosure concerns a verified set of records from a software and digitization services organization in Vietnam. The material scheduled for publication comprises personnel records including national identity numbers, personal tax codes, social-insurance numbers and bank account details, together with identity-document images and business records including customer and contract material. Representative records have been examined and verified as genuine. Once published, the complete data set can be examined, downloaded, and redistributed without restriction.
